quality.title: From source to sealed bottle
quality.body: Every drop of Oxyrich water goes through a 12-step purification and enrichment process, followed by laboratory checks, before it reaches your door.
quality.labBody: Regular tests by certified experts verify purity, mineral levels and safety, and every batch is checked against health and safety standards — monitored from source to bottle.
quality.certsBody: Certificates and lab reports will be published here.

1.title: Source intake
1.body: Raw water is drawn and screened before it enters the plant.

2.title: Sediment filtration
2.body: Sand and sediment filters remove suspended particles.

3.title: Activated carbon
3.body: Carbon filtration reduces chlorine, odour and organic compounds.

4.title: Water softening
4.body: Hardness minerals that cause scale are reduced.

5.title: Micron filtration
5.body: Fine cartridge filters capture the smallest particles.

6.title: Reverse osmosis
6.body: A membrane removes dissolved impurities and contaminants.

7.title: Mineral balancing
7.body: Essential minerals are added back in measured amounts for taste and health.

8.title: Oxygen enrichment
8.body: Water is enriched with oxygen for a fresh, light taste.

9.title: UV sterilisation
9.body: Ultraviolet light neutralises bacteria and viruses without chemicals.

10.title: Ozonation
10.body: Ozone disinfects the water and keeps it fresh in the bottle.

11.title: Bottle washing
11.body: Bottles are washed, rinsed and sanitised before every fill.

12.title: Filling & sealing
12.body: Bottles are filled and sealed in a hygienic area, then batch-checked.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Can't find what you're looking for? Call or WhatsApp us any time — we're open 24/7.

areas.q: Which areas do you deliver to?
areas.a: We deliver across Islamabad, including the I, G, F, E and H sectors, DHA and Bahria Town. Use the delivery checker on our home page, or message us on WhatsApp if your area isn't listed.

timings.a: We are open Monday to Sunday, 24/7. Place your order any time and we'll call to confirm a delivery slot that suits you.

fee.a: Yes. Delivery is free across our service areas.

deposit.q: How does the 19 litre bottle deposit work?
deposit.a: 19 litre bottles are returnable. With your first order we charge a refundable deposit for each bottle. On every repeat order, simply hand back your empty bottle and you pay only for the water. Your account shows how many of our bottles you currently hold.

return.q: Can I return bottles and get my deposit back?
return.a: Yes. If you no longer need our service, return your bottles in good condition and we'll refund the deposit. Contact us to arrange a collection.

minimum.a: You can order a single 19 litre bottle. For cartons and bulk orders, call or WhatsApp us and we'll confirm the best option for your area.

payment.a: Pay cash on delivery. We'll confirm the total when we call to confirm your order.

subscription.q: Can I set up a regular delivery?
subscription.a: Yes. Create a weekly or bi-weekly delivery plan for 19 litre bottles. You can skip or pause the next delivery any time from your account.
